How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Fellow position is 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Research Fellow position at the Institute of Home Economics Delhi University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters degree in Development Communication & Extension, Resource Management, or Extension Education, along with relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month, plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Institute of Home Economics Delhi University located?
faq.answer: The Institute of Home Economics Delhi University is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110016.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract job opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article.
